summary: Connect ChartFox from the desktop app, and a cleaner phone and iPad experience.
releaseNotes: Connect in the desktop app's Charts opens the web EFB in your browser and starts the ChartFox sign-in.
The installed app can rotate on iPad.
Updating on iPhone or iPad reloads the app instead of downloading a desktop installer.
The phone map no longer has a dark bar under the status bar.
The 'PC not found' message no longer appears on phones.
